activity_summary: Mistress Ansell boiled the Monday ink from galls, copperas, and gum, and filled the horn at twopence. You ate at the board for threepence. You told her only that a letter in the play never came. Gib stayed on the Holinshed. You did not open Field's book. You were cast in the Navarre comedy at two.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid the twopence, ate, and kept the plot out of the kitchen.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Boiled the receipt, named the price, and refused a second telling of Saturday.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Set the trencher and left the cat where he was.

facets.activity: Paid for the horn and ate before the play

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Twopence the horn, as it has always been.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: There is a letter in the play that never came.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Six years he has been dead, at this tide, and the receipt is still blacker than the scriveners.
